answer:
An aspiring-page record carries four attributes:
- `name`: the unresolved page name.
- `page`: the source page that contains the link.
- `pos`: the start of the unresolved link.
- `ref`: the reference that identifies that occurrence.

No, X-Ray won't underline it. Aspiring-page records have no `range`, and X-Ray doesn't show `range`-less objects. (From `Tag/aspiring-page.md` and `X-Ray.md`.)
